Member to receive an online receipt via SMS that opens in a browser. The Vendor may embed a standard HTTPS URL hyperlink within the text message. When the recipient taps this link, their smartphone's browser will be prompted to open the specified webpage, which displays the receipt. This is especially helpful for situations where receipt is to be provided to farmer and the PACS is experiencing a power cut or printer out of service for any other reason.
